mentions.name: Matcha
mentions.description: This app is an in-browser "pre-editor" for cutting down a long sequence of repeated takes for talking-head content to just the segments you want to keep. It aligns cuts to the speaker's pose so they don't land mid-blink or mid-word, exports cuts to Final Cut Pro and DaVinci for existing editing workflows, provides a transcript editor with retake grouping and word-level cuts, and detects dysfluencies like "um" and "uh". It is free and in-browser, with an optional paid tier for faster/better server speech recognition (ASR); it is currently in beta with free server ASR for new users.
mentions.problem: Cutting down long sequences of repeated takes for talking-head videos is tedious, and manual cuts risk interrupting the speaker mid-blink or mid-word.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://matcha.video - In-browser "pre-editor" for cutting down a long sequence of repeated takes for talking-head content to just the stuff you want to keep.
